title: NDT Engineer
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **NDT Level III Technician** to lead and supervise Non\-Destructive Testing activities for shipbuilding, ship repair, fabrication, piping, structural and marine engineering projects. The candidate will be responsible for developing and approving NDT procedures, ensuring compliance with applicable standards, reviewing test results and providing technical guidance to NDT personnel.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop, review and approve **NDT procedures, techniques and work instructions**.
* Provide technical supervision for **UT, RT, MT, PT, VT** and other applicable NDT methods.
* Interpret NDT codes, standards, specifications and client requirements.
* Review and approve NDT reports, test results and inspection documentation.
* Ensure NDT activities comply with applicable **class, statutory, client and project requirements**.
* Provide technical guidance to Level I and Level II NDT technicians.
* Review and validate NDT personnel qualifications, certifications and competency.
* Coordinate NDT activities with **QA/QC, Production, Planning, Project and Welding teams**.
* Support inspection activities for **hull structures, weld joints, piping, pressure vessels, machinery and marine equipment**.
* Evaluate weld discontinuities and assist Welding/QC teams in determining acceptance or rejection as per applicable standards.
* Review radiographs, ultrasonic indications and other NDT results where authorized.
* Prepare and maintain NDT procedures, reports, records, calibration certificates and personnel qualification documents.
* Coordinate with **Class Surveyors, Client Inspectors and Third\-Party Inspection Agencies** during NDT activities.
* Ensure proper calibration and maintenance of NDT equipment.
* Investigate recurring defects and support **Root Cause Analysis and corrective actions**.
* Monitor NDT subcontractors and verify compliance with approved procedures and project requirements.
* Participate in inspection planning, quality meetings and project review meetings.
* Ensure proper control and traceability of NDT records and reports.
* Promote safe working practices during NDT operations, particularly during **radiography and confined\-space inspections**.

Technical Competencies

The candidate should have strong knowledge of:

* **Ultrasonic Testing (UT)**
* **Radiographic Testing (RT)**
* **Magnetic Particle Testing (MT)**
* **Liquid Penetrant Testing (PT)**
* **Visual Testing (VT)**
* Weld inspection and weld discontinuity evaluation
* NDT procedure preparation and approval
* NDT report interpretation and review
* Welding technology and fabrication processes
* Shipbuilding and ship\-repair inspection practices
* Applicable **ASME, ASTM, AWS, ISO and Class requirements**
* NDT acceptance criteria and inspection standards
* Calibration and verification of NDT equipment
* NDT documentation and quality records

Qualification \& Certification

* Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in **Mechanical / Metallurgy / Production / Marine Engineering** or equivalent.
* **NDT Level III certification** in relevant methods from a recognized certification scheme.
* ASNT / PCN / ISO 9712 or equivalent certification will be preferred.
* Valid certification in relevant NDT methods is required.
* Knowledge of ship classification requirements such as **IRS, DNV, ABS, LR, BV or equivalent** will be an advantage.

Experience

* **8–15\+ years of relevant NDT experience**, preferably in:
* Shipbuilding
* Ship repair
* Marine engineering
* Heavy fabrication
* Pressure vessels
* Offshore / structural fabrication
* Previous experience in **NDT Level III responsibilities and procedure approval** is highly desirable.
* Experience dealing with Class Surveyors and client inspection teams will be an advantage.

Key Skills

* Strong technical knowledge of NDT methods
* Excellent interpretation and analytical skills
* Knowledge of welding and fabrication
* Good documentation and reporting skills
* Strong coordination and communication skills
* Ability to lead NDT teams independently
* Attention to detail and quality consciousness
* Ability to work under project deadlines
* Strong understanding of HSE requirements

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance

title: Associate – Brand Communications
description:
**Job Summary**

The Associate – Website Design, UI/UX \& Graphic Design at Cavli Wireless will support the comprehensive revamp and continuous improvement of the company’s digital presence by creating intuitive, responsive, and visually engaging web experiences. This role requires a hybrid creative who can seamlessly bridge the gap between structured UI/UX design and high\-impact graphic design. The ideal candidate combines research\-driven design thinking with a modern, forward\-looking workflow, actively leveraging AI tools to accelerate productivity, creativity, and project execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Website Design \& UI/UX (Revamp Focus)**

* Design responsive, user\-centric website pages, landing pages, and digital experiences aligned with Cavli’s brand identity and technical goals.
* Develop wireframes, user flows, high\-fidelity designs, interactive prototypes, and reusable design components to streamline the website revamp process.
* Prepare developer\-ready designs, precise specifications, and assets, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure smooth handoff and robust design quality assurance (QA).
* Improve website navigation, information architecture, content hierarchy, and web accessibility to optimize the overall user journey.
* Analyze website analytics, heatmaps, and user feedback to identify friction points and implement data\-driven design optimizations.
* Create and maintain reusable UI components, design libraries, and digital design systems.
* Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and responsively.

**Graphic Design \& Branding**

* Create high\-quality B2B marketing creatives, social media assets, corporate presentations, brochures, infographics, and other digital collateral to support branding and marketing initiatives.
* Maintain strict visual consistency across all web and marketing assets through the precise application of typography, grid systems, color theory, and established brand guidelines.
* Conduct competitor research, visual audits, and industry benchmarking to keep Cavli’s marketing materials and brand aesthetics modern and competitive.
* Develop visual concepts for product launches, thought\-leadership campaigns, webinars, exhibitions, and corporate communications.
* Support booth graphics, signage, product displays, event branding, and presentation materials.
* Manage multiple design projects while ensuring quality and adherence to deadlines.

**AI\-Assisted Design \& Workflow Automation**

* Actively leverage AI\-powered tools for design exploration, rapid prototyping, mood boarding, asset generation, and workflow automation.
* Utilize AI engines to assist in research, competitive benchmarking, design documentation, and initial content ideation.
* Evaluate, refine, and polish AI\-generated outputs to guarantee absolute originality, pixel\-perfect accuracy, and alignment with Cavli's strict brand guidelines.
* Stay at the forefront of the industry by continuously identifying, testing, and adopting new AI technologies that improve design team efficiency and output quality.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Design, Visual Communication, Multimedia, Human\-Computer Interaction, or a related field (equivalent practical experience will be considered).
* 2\-3 years of professional experience in a role handling website design, UI/UX design, and digital graphic design.
* A strong portfolio showcasing two distinct pillars: 1\) live, responsive web design/UI projects 2\) clean, corporate marketing graphics
* Excellent communication and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions clearly to both developers and marketing stakeholders.

**Preferred Technical Skills**

* Advanced proficiency in Figma (specifically components, auto\-layout, and prototyping) and Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).
* Deep understanding of responsive design, web grid systems, typography, and web accessibility standards (WCAG).
* Practical knowledge of developer handoff protocols and design QA processes.
* Familiarity with how web design influences SEO and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
* Hands\-on experience with user behavior tools (e.g., Hotjar, Microsoft Clarity) and Google Analytics.
* Experience in using AI tools (e.g., Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Canva AI) to augment daily research, design, and project workflows.
* Experience developing and maintaining **design systems**, reusable UI components, style guides, templates, and brand libraries.

title: NDT Technician
description:

We are looking for a skilled **NDT Technician** with experience in **shipbuilding, ship repair, marine, fabrication, or heavy engineering** to carry out non\-destructive testing and inspection of welds, structures, piping, and other components. The candidate should be familiar with NDT procedures, inspection standards, safety requirements, and preparation of accurate inspection reports.

* Inspect welds, plates, pipes, structural members, pressure components, and repaired areas.
* Identify and evaluate weld discontinuities, defects, cracks, porosity, lack of fusion, undercut, etc.
* Verify inspection areas and test locations as per approved drawings and inspection requirements.
* Calibrate and perform routine checks of NDT equipment before use.
* Record inspection results accurately and prepare NDT reports.
* Maintain proper documentation, inspection records, test reports, and traceability.

* Conduct re\-inspection of repaired/reworked areas and verify compliance.
* Ensure NDT activities are carried out in accordance with applicable **class, client, statutory, and project requirements**.
* Maintain NDT equipment, accessories, consumables, and calibration records.
* Follow all applicable **HSE and radiation\-safety requirements**, particularly during RT activities.
* Support client/class surveyors during inspection and testing.
* Report inspection findings and non\-conformities to the concerned QA/QC Engineer or NDT Level II/III personnel.

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / ITI / Technical qualification in Mechanical, Welding, NDT, or a related field.
* Valid certification in relevant NDT methods such as:
* **UT – Ultrasonic Testing**
* **MT/MPI – Magnetic Particle Testing**
* **PT/DPT – Dye Penetrant Testing**
* **RT – Radiographic Testing**, if applicable
* Certification as per relevant **ASNT / ISO 9712 / PCN** or equivalent requirements will be preferred.
* Practical experience in **shipyard, ship repair, marine, fabrication, or heavy engineering** is preferred.

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of weld inspection and NDT techniques.
* Ability to interpret **engineering drawings, weld symbols, inspection procedures, and specifications**.
* Knowledge of relevant **ASME, ASTM, AWS, ISO and classification society requirements**.
* Familiarity with acceptance criteria for weld and material defects.
* Ability to prepare clear and accurate NDT reports.
* Basic computer knowledge for documentation and reporting.

Desired Competencies

* Strong attention to detail.
* Good observation and analytical skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a QA/QC team.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Willingness to work in **shipyard, dock, vessel, and outdoor environments**.
* Commitment to safety and quality standards.

Key Performance Areas

* Accuracy and reliability of NDT inspection.
* Timely completion of inspection activities.
* Proper identification and reporting of defects.
* Compliance with approved NDT procedures and applicable standards.
* Proper maintenance of inspection records and equipment.

About the Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission
  
  

The Aged Care Quality and Safety Commission is the national regulator of Australian Government\-funded aged care services.
  
  

We protect and enhance the safety, health, wellbeing, and quality of life of people receiving aged care. This includes managing complaints and feedback about the care older people receive.
  
  

We help build confidence and trust in aged care, by promoting best practice and a culture of safety and quality in the sector. We register providers and hold them to account if they don’t meet expected standards of care.
  
  

We work with providers, workers, older people, their families, and supporters to make sure they understand and uphold older people’s rights.
  
  

Meet some of our people and learn more about the Commission and our Regulatory Strategy on our website www.agedcarequality.gov.au
  
  

About the Team
  
  

Cyber Section
  
  

Safeguarding the Commission’s digital assets, information, and infrastructure from cyber threats and security breaches, the Cyber team focuses on implementing robust security measures, policies, and practices to protect against unauthorised access, data breaches, and cyber\-attacks.
  
  

About the Role
  
  

The Assistant Director, Information Governance leads the team responsible for strengthening how the Commission creates, manages, protects, uses, retains and disposes of information. The role ensures information is treated as a strategic asset: trusted, discoverable, secure, accessible when needed and managed in line with legislative, policy and National Archives of Australia expectations.
  
  

As an EL1 leader in the Digital Group, the position connects information governance practice with the Commission’s regulatory purpose, digital and data priorities, risk appetite and service outcomes. The role provides practical leadership across information management, recordkeeping, assurance, cyber security, privacy and responsible technology use, helping the Commission make confident, evidence\-based decisions and maintain public trust.
  
  

Position Duties
  
  

**Lead information governance:** Develop and improve information governance frameworks, policies, standards, procedures and guidance that align to business outcomes, regulatory responsibilities and the Commission’s digital and data priorities.
  
**Deliver recordkeeping and information management outcomes:** Support the proper creation, capture, management, preservation, access, retention and disposal of Commission information in line with the Archives Act, records authorities, National Archives of Australia guidance and Commission requirements.
  
**Strengthen information stewardship:** Improve ownership, classification, metadata, access, sensitivity, handling and lifecycle controls so information assets are discoverable, usable, trusted and appropriately protected.
  
**Manage information risk and assurance:** Identify, assess, manage and report information governance, recordkeeping, privacy, information handling and emerging technology risks, and coordinate assurance activities, remediation and reporting.
  
**Align with cyber security, privacy and the ISMS:** Work with cyber security, privacy, legal, technology and business stakeholders to embed information governance requirements into secure\-by\-design services, access controls, classification, incident response and business continuity practices.
  
**Support responsible technology use:** Provide practical governance for AI, automation, analytics and other emerging technologies, ensuring information inputs, outputs and records are managed according to value, sensitivity, ownership, retention, privacy, security and accountability requirements.
  
**Build capability and culture:** Develop clear guidance, education, communications and stakeholder engagement that help staff understand and meet their information management responsibilities.
  
**Provide strategic advice:** Give clear, evidence\-based advice to executives, managers and service owners on information governance, records management, information risk, privacy and lifecycle management.
  
**Lead the team and deliver results:** Set direction, clarify priorities, allocate work, build capability, manage performance, support wellbeing and deliver agreed outcomes while managing risks, dependencies and changing priorities.
  
**Drive continuous improvement:** Use evidence, feedback, reporting and lessons learned to improve information governance services, tools, registers, controls and assurance processes.
  
**Other duties:** Perform other duties as required, consistent with the classification, work level standards and direction of the Director.
  
  

**Position Eligibility Requirements (Selection Criteria):**  

To be successful in this role you will need to demonstrate the following:
  
  

**Strategic thinking:** Connects information governance work to the Commission’s purpose, regulatory responsibilities and digital and data priorities, using evidence and judgement to solve complex problems.
  
**Delivery and accountability:** Plans and delivers quality outcomes, manages priorities, risks and dependencies, and follows through on commitments with clear evidence and documentation.
  
**People and change leadership:** Provides direction, supports staff and stakeholders through change, builds capability and creates a positive, accountable and service\-oriented team culture.
  
**Stakeholder engagement:** Builds productive relationships across Digital, Data, Privacy, Legal, Governance, business areas, providers and government partners to achieve practical information governance outcomes.
  
**Communication and influence:** Explains complex information governance, recordkeeping, privacy, risk and assurance matters clearly and provides advice that supports informed decisions.
  
**Professional judgement and integrity:** Models ethical information handling, sound judgement, professionalism, resilience and a strong commitment to public accountability.
  
**Information governance expertise:** Applies strong knowledge of Australian Government information management, recordkeeping, lifecycle management, metadata, retention, disposal, discovery, preservation and relevant obligations, including the Archives Act, Privacy Act, PSPF and Commission policies.
  
**Risk, assurance and responsible digital practice:** Designs proportionate controls and assurance approaches for information, privacy, security and emerging technology risks, supporting trusted, secure and responsible digital and data outcomes.
  
**Security clearance:** Baseline Security Clearance, or ability to obtain and maintain.
  
  

**Position Notes:**  

Salary offered will be between $122,620 \- $139,850 per annum depending on skills and experience. In addition, 15\.4% superannuation will be paid.
  
Only candidates who hold Australian citizenship can apply. Appointment is conditional on successfully completing a national police check. For more information, please visit www.apsc.gov.au/citizenship\-aps
  
Non\-ongoing opportunity will be offered for an irregular/intermittent term. Opportunities will be offered for varying periods up to 12 months with the option to extend to a total of 24 months.
  
Merit Pool established through this selection process may be used to fill this or future ongoing or non\-ongoing vacancies.
  
In your application, please provide a statement of claims against the position eligibility requirements (selection criteria) in no more than 600\-words , including what strengths you would bring to the role, and a copy of your CV.
  
  

Please complete the application and submit by 1 October 2026 at 11:30PM
  
Follow our guidelines for candidate use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) throughout the recruitment process.

title: Fabrication Supervisor
description:
**Job Summary**

The Fabrication Supervisor oversees day\-to\-day shop floor operations, directing a team of fabricators, welders, and machine operators. This role ensures projects are completed on schedule, within design specifications, and in full compliance with safety and quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Production Oversight:** Plan, schedule, and assign daily workloads for cutting, bending, forming, fit\-up, and welding operations to meet delivery deadlines.
* **Technical Guidance:** Interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and weld symbols (WPS) to guide fabricators through complex assemblies.
* **Quality Assurance:** Inspect in\-process and finished assemblies for dimensional accuracy and weld integrity; ensure adherence to ASME, AWS, or project\-specific standards.
* **Safety \& Compliance:** Enforce OSHA regulations, site\-specific safety protocols, tool\-box talks, and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage across the shop floor.
* **Equipment \& Inventory Maintenance:** Oversee preventive maintenance schedules for shop equipment (CNC plasma/laser cutters, press brakes, welding rigs) and monitor raw material stock (sheets, structural shapes, consumables).
* **Team Leadership:** Track crew performance, conduct hands\-on training, resolve shop floor bottlenecks, and manage timekeeping and attendance.

**Qualifications \& Requirements**

* **Experience:** 10\+ years in metal fabrication/marine fabrication or structural steel manufacturing

Work Location: In person

title: QC Welding Inspector
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **Welding Inspector** with 4–7 years of experience in **shipbuilding, ship repair, marine, fabrication, or heavy engineering**. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring and inspecting welding activities to ensure compliance with approved drawings, WPS, ITPs, applicable standards, class requirements, and project specifications.

Key Responsibilities

* Inspect welding and fabrication activities at various stages of production.
* Verify welding work against **approved drawings, WPS, specifications and ITP requirements**.
* Check joint preparation, fit\-up, alignment, root gap, bevel angle and cleanliness before welding.
* Verify welder qualification and ensure qualified welders are deployed for the applicable welding process and position.
* Monitor welding parameters, preheating and interpass temperature as specified in the WPS.
* Conduct **visual inspection (VT)** of completed welds and identify welding defects.
* Coordinate with NDT personnel for **PT, MT, UT and RT** as applicable.
* Review NDT reports and ensure defects are properly repaired and re\-inspected.
* Verify welding consumables, storage, handling and traceability.
* Check material identification and traceability against relevant material certificates.
* Prepare and maintain inspection reports, checklists and quality records.
* Raise/coordinate **NCRs** for non\-conforming welding work and follow up on corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Production, Engineering, QA/QC and Class/Client representatives during inspections.
* Participate in stage inspections, hold points and final inspections.
* Ensure proper documentation and traceability of welding activities.
* Support preparation of quality dossiers and final inspection documentation.
* Ensure compliance with company HSE requirements while carrying out inspection activities.

Required Technical Knowledge

* Welding processes such as **SMAW, FCAW, GMAW/MIG\-MAG and GTAW/TIG**.
* Welding defects and their identification.
* WPS, PQR/WPQR and welder qualification requirements.
* Fit\-up and dimensional inspection.
* Basic knowledge of NDT methods and interpretation of NDT reports.
* ITP, inspection checklists and NCR procedures.
* Material identification and traceability.
* Engineering drawings and welding symbols.
* Basic knowledge of **shipbuilding/ship\-repair practices and Class requirements**.

Qualification

* **Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering or equivalent.**
* Welding Inspection certification such as **CSWIP 3\.1 / AWS CWI / equivalent** will be an advantage.
* NDT Level II certification in relevant methods will be preferred.

Experience

* **4–7 years of relevant experience** in welding inspection.
* Experience in **shipyard, ship repair, marine fabrication, offshore, pressure vessels or heavy engineering** is preferred.

Key Skills

* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to read and understand engineering drawings and welding symbols.
* Good inspection and reporting skills.
* Effective coordination with Production and Engineering teams.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently at a shipyard/site environment.
* Strong commitment to quality and safety.

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹45,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid sick time

Work Location: In person
